items.body:
A fishing boat had broken up on the reef, and its crew of forty were in lifeboats, rowing blind through the storm towards the only light they could see: Mara's lamp.

But the lighthouse stands on sheer rocks with nowhere to land. The only safe beach was in the bay below the village, where the villagers had lit a bonfire. With the lamp dark, the bonfire was the brightest light on the coast, so the lifeboats steered for it and landed safely.
